(nil suspends) and inlineCursor(accepting:_:) serves only accepted requests (accepts before claim, the exchange passed to the server, held weakly). OriginalMacRuntimeMenu.step serves .queue requests inline while served+1 < maximumRequests, counting requests and lastRequest as the permit path does; the request bound is kept (the request reaching it goes through the permit path). servesQueueInline (default true) allows side-by-side tests.
